item.title: Middle East War: Trump postpones Iran ultimatum amid TACO accusations
item.description: According to Donald Trump, after postponing his threat to attack power plants, Iran is ready to make a deal, declaring "we've eliminated everything there is to eliminate".

item.title: Oil prices surge and plummet as markets react to US-Israel conflict with Iran
item.description: There were wild swings on the financial markets today, with oil prices plummeting on the hint of peace but then surging again as doubts set in.

item.title: Oil is Iran’s ‘low-cost’ global disruption tool says former US diplomat
item.description: We spoke to Jennifer Gavito, who served as US Deputy Assistant Secretary for Iran and Iraq in President Joe Biden’s administration from 2021-23.

item.title: Global diplomacy needed to end Iran war, says peace strategist
item.description: We spoke to Sanam Naraghi Anderlini MBE, founder and CEO of International Civil Society Action Network.

item.title: Iran war ‘could go on for some time’ says Keir Starmer
item.description: Prime Minister Keir Starmer has told MPs that the UK should be prepared for the Iran war to carry on "for some time", stressing that he didn't want Britain to be dragged into it.

item.title: Jewish charity ambulance attack investigated by counter terrorism police
item.description: Counter terrorism police are leading the investigation into a suspected antisemitic hate crime in North London, after four ambulances belonging to a Jewish volunteer group were set on fire, in a synagogue car park. Nearby homes had to be evacuated as a precaution.

item.title: Labour government reveals plans for seven new towns in England
item.description: The government has revealed the location of seven potential new towns across England, each delivering between 10,000 and 40,000 new homes.

item.title: Israeli tanks mass on Lebanon’s border increasing invasion fears
item.description: In Lebanon, there have been further Israeli airstrikes, including one targeting another bridge in the south of the country, which is becoming increasingly cut off from the rest of Lebanon.

item.title: Israel must ‘achieve key objectives’ before Iran ceasefire – Naftali Bennett
item.description: We spoke to former Israeli Prime Minister Naftali Bennett.

item.title: How UK has become a country music hotspot
item.description: Once the soundtrack to rural, small-town America, country music is now having its UK moment thanks to streaming platforms putting the genre in front of a new generation, writes Minnie Stephenson.
